interpretation: EVIDENCED means a tracked artifact answers the criterion today. AWAITS_REVIEW means the work is implemented but a human judgment is required and has not happened. GATED means an authority this repository does not hold is required. Neither AWAITS_REVIEW nor GATED is a pass, and no combination of these states is a GA claim.
